{"bugs_found": ["SJISDistributionAnalysis.get_order uses `first_char >= 0x81 or first_char <= 0x9F`, which makes the first-byte range condition effectively always true instead of requiring `0x81 <= first_char <= 0x9F`.", "SJISDistributionAnalysis.get_order accepts invalid first bytes such as 0xA0, 0xDF, and 0xF0 when second_char <= 0x7F, violating the contract that those return -1.", "SJISDistributionAnalysis.get_order never reaches the 0xE0..0xEF branch, so valid upper Shift-JIS first bytes are mapped with the wrong offset instead of `188 * (first_char - 0xE0 + 31)`.", "SJISDistributionAnalysis.get_order may return arbitrary negative values for invalid low first bytes instead of the contractually required -1."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
